concept:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished ORIGINAL ensemble concept sheet for a cute mobile defense-game IP called Seasonal Knot Martialists (working title, do not print title). Eight distinct ADULT human martial artists who fold weather into cloth knots and ceramic charms. This is an original martial-arts/weather-transformation fantasy, not any existing anime franchise. Exactly eight full-body characters, two rows of four, spacious equal cells on warm ivory paper, each a consistent 2.5-head-tall SD game figure, front-facing three-quarter view, all feet visible and same grounded scale. Hand-drawn confident dark warm outlines, crisp gouache-like color shapes, controlled soft 2.5D volume, charming expressive faces, excellent silhouette readability, not shiny 3D plastic, not photorealistic, no generic AI ornate clutter. Small restrained weather motifs next to each person's hands, not huge VFX covering anatomy. No weapons resembling guns or famous character costumes, no spiky golden hair, no orange martial uniforms, no recognizable copyrighted logos. Unified design motifs: asymmetrically folded cloth, one distinctive flat ceramic weather-knot clasp, practical wrapped hands/feet. Rich but tasteful ink navy, terracotta, jade, apricot and plum colors with individual accents. Do not make eight identical outfits, faces or silhouettes. Tiny number labels 01 to 08 only, no other text.
Top row left to right:
01 NADO: petite energetic adult woman, short blunt ink-black bob with little side notch, apricot-yellow cropped squared jacket, navy culotte shorts, oversized soft brick-red wrapped boxing mitts, one small red sun-knot at belt. Cheerful direct punch stance, round compact silhouette. A small flat warm sun ring at one fist.
02 DEUN: stocky friendly adult man, tan skin, swept-back dark blue hair, mint triangular short poncho over cream cropped trousers, navy wrapped calves, long two-ended wind ribbons attached to ankles. Side-on lifted heel stance with visible friendly face; broad triangle silhouette. One curved mint wind stroke low at ankle.
03 SORI: tall elegant adult woman, warm brown skin, long navy braid loop, fitted teal sleeveless vest and flowing indigo wide-leg pants, narrow red sash, large OPEN RIBBON FAN shaped like three folded raindrop panels held beside shoulder, no umbrella. Attentive sideways palm pose, narrow tall silhouette, three small rain beads.
04 BOJUN: broad muscular adult man, dark brown skin, shaved head with one short white plait behind, ochre padded sleeveless vest and burgundy trousers, TWO huge angular terracotta ceramic forearm guards, practical short boots. Low planted horse stance, strong square silhouette. Small dust diamond near fist.
Bottom row left to right:
05 RYEON: cool adult woman, silver asymmetrical short bob, plum short wrap-coat with a very high folded collar, pale-blue crescent-shaped scarf, slate tapered trousers and boots. One hand open in precise cutting stance, sleek crescent silhouette, two small geometric frost shards.
06 HAON: athletic playful adult man, medium brown skin, dark auburn rounded tied hair, plum sleeveless bomber with cream chest wrap, cobalt short trousers over leggings, two small copper fork-shaped wrist braces, jaunty twin-palm stance. Zigzag sleeve tails and a short ochre lightning ribbon, no huge hair or spikes.
07 MURE: kind older adult woman, warm olive skin, thick long gray side braid, round layered cloud-gray shawl with peach lining, amber woven belt, dark teal skirt-trousers. Holding a short ring-ended wooden staff at chest level, wise cheerful expression. Round cape silhouette, small white fog loop connecting her hands. No lantern.
08 SEOLGI: poised adult woman, pale tan skin, long dark jade hair in low braid, ivory split-tail coat with broad jade lining and coral knotted sash, flat pale boots, three small folded hexagonal weather seals in a fan-like arc behind one shoulder. Balanced open-palm stance, elegant asymmetric mantle silhouette. A subtle season-wheel mark at one palm. Not taller or physically bigger than other cast members.
High-quality cohesive game art direction, equal rendering quality for all eight, no duplicate people, no additional humans, no merged hands, no cut-off feet, no background scene, generous white space.
sd: Edit the supplied original eight-person Seasonal Knot Martialists ensemble into a SECOND GAME-UNIT DESIGN SHEET of those exact SAME EIGHT characters, preserving their identities, colors, costume motifs, age cues, skin tones, tools, numbering and row order. Essential change: all eight become genuinely compact 2.3-HEAD-TALL SD/chibi defense pieces (huge head, very short torso, short strong legs, hands/tools clearly readable), consistent scale and same foot baseline within each row. Their whole height should be roughly 2.3 times their head height, NOT the long 4-to-5-head figures in the reference. Top01 sun boxer with black short hair and red mitts,02 mint wind male with long tied navy hair and ankle ribbons,03 brown-skinned navy rain-fan woman,04 dark-skinned bald sturdy earth man with white braid and terracotta fists. Bottom05 silver-bob plum frost woman,06 auburn tied-hair lightning male with copper wrist forks,07 smiling elderly fog woman with gray braid and ring-ended staff,08 jade-braid ivory/coral season-seal woman. Keep adults recognizable in a cute toy-sized rendition, not infants. Simplify folds and decorative details to broad readable shapes. Pose toward viewer at a slight raised front angle suitable for a 4x4 board. Exactly 8 separate full-body figures in spacious 2x4 layout, warm ivory plain background, restrained shadow directly under both feet, all feet fully visible, no environment. 07 and08 must be no larger than01. 08 has THREE folded season seals at shoulder, small enough not to increase footprint. Quiet weather accents, no big particles or motion streaks covering bodies. Crisp hand-drawn warm outlines with soft 2.5D gouache volume, charming collectible game pieces, NOT pixel art, NOT photorealism, NOT shiny plastic. Small label numbers01..08 only. This is a concept sheet, not a sprite atlas; no UI, no additional characters or logo. Preserve distinct silhouettes and avoid identical faces.
